# CuteCode: Full Documentation

> CuteCode is an open-source code screenshot tool and ray.so alternative. Create beautiful images and videos of your code with 65+ themes, publish snippets to shareable URLs, and remix other people's snippets. Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

---

## Overview

CuteCode lets developers and designers turn code into stunning, shareable images and videos. Choose from 65+ curated themes, including brand themes inspired by companies like Vercel, Stripe, and OpenAI, paste your code, and export a pixel-perfect screenshot in seconds. Every snippet can be published to a unique URL and remixed by anyone.

**Website:** https://www.cutecode.app
**GitHub:** https://github.com/simpleneeraj/cool-snippets
**Author:** simpleneeraj
**License:** MIT

---

## Pages & Routes

- [Homepage](https://www.cutecode.app): The main code screenshot editor. Paste code, pick a theme, customize, and export.
- [Snippets](https://www.cutecode.app/snippets): View and manage your saved code snippets (requires sign-in).
- [Pricing](https://www.cutecode.app/pricing): Compare Free, Pro and Premium plans.
- Preview (https://www.cutecode.app/preview/{slug}): Public page for a published snippet.
- Remix (https://www.cutecode.app/remix/{slug}): Open a copy of a public snippet in your own editor.
- Profile (https://www.cutecode.app/u/{userId}): A user's public profile with their published snippets.
- Embed (https://www.cutecode.app/embed/{slug}): Embeddable code preview for blogs and docs.
- [Sign In](https://www.cutecode.app/account/sign-in): Sign in with email and password, GitHub, or Google.
- [Sign Up](https://www.cutecode.app/account/sign-up): Create a new CuteCode account.

---

## Features

### Code Screenshot Generator
- Paste or type code into the editor
- Automatic language detection and manual language selection
- Syntax highlighting for 100+ programming languages via Shiki
- Customizable padding, font size, and background
- Window-style frame with macOS-style traffic light buttons
- Line numbers toggle
- Typing animation and multi-slide reels

### 65+ Built-in Themes
CuteCode ships with 65+ themes organized into groups: **Brands**, **Classic**, **Night**, **Cozy**, **Romantic**, **Lofi**, **Vintage**, **Retro**, and **Seasonal**.

#### Brands (18)
Color palettes inspired by popular developer tools and companies:

1. Vercel
2. Supabase
3. Tailwind
4. OpenAI
5. Mintlify
6. Prisma
7. Clerk
8. ElevenLabs
9. Resend
10. Trigger.dev
11. Nuxt
12. Browserbase
13. Cloudflare
14. Gemini
15. Stripe
16. Claude AI
17. Firecrawl
18. Evil Rabbit

#### Other Themes (51)
Handcrafted palettes for artistic and creative code screenshots:

- **Classic:** Bitmap, Breeze, Candy, Carbon Night, Crimson, Dusk, Ember, Falcon, Fjord, Forest, Ice, Latte, Meadow, Midnight, Mono, Neon City, Noir, Paper, Petal, Raindrop, Sand, Sunset
- **Night:** Aurora Nights, Neon Dreams, Starry Night, Velvet Night
- **Cozy:** Coffee Date, Frosted Glass, Golden Hour, Peachy Mood, Sunset Chill
- **Romantic:** Love, Roses, Strawberry Milk, Valentine
- **Lofi:** Cassette, Lofi Rain, Lofi Rooftop, Vinyl
- **Vintage:** Groovy 70s, Instant Film, Typewriter, Home Video
- **Retro:** PS6, Retro Mac
- **Seasonal:** Christmas, Diwali, Halloween, Holi, Lunar New Year, New Year, Winter Frost

### Export & Sharing
- **Image export:** PNG and SVG at 1x and 2x (3x on Pro, up to 4x on Premium)
- **Copy to clipboard:** One-click copy for pasting into docs, slides, or social media
- **GIF and video export:** Animated exports with typing animation (HD video on Premium)
- **Publish via URL:** Every published snippet gets a unique /preview/{slug} URL
- **Embed:** Use /embed/{slug} to embed live code previews in blogs and documentation

### Snippet Publishing & Remixing
- Save snippets to your account (requires sign-in)
- Every published snippet gets a unique URL that preserves code, theme, and settings
- Anyone can view a public snippet and remix it into their own editor
- Public profile pages list each user's published snippets

### Dark & Light Mode
- Full dark mode and light mode support
- Automatic system preference detection
- Manual toggle available in the UI

### Authentication
- Powered by Better Auth
- Sign in with email and password, GitHub, or Google
- Required for saving and publishing snippets and for paid plans

### Plans
- **Free ($0):** All Classic and Brand themes, PNG, SVG and copy at 1x and 2x, GIF and video export with watermark, typing animation and multi-slide reels, limited daily publishes and live snippets
- **Pro ($5/month or $48/year):** Everything in Free, premium animated themes and fonts, 3x image export, no watermark on images or video, 30 publishes a day with unlimited live snippets
- **Premium ($12/month or $120/year):** Everything in Pro, 4x image export, HD video exports, passcode and private shares, per-snippet analytics, 100 publishes a day

## Tech Stack

| Technology | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Next.js 16** | App Router, Server Components, API routes |
| **React 19** | UI rendering with latest concurrent features |
| **TypeScript** | Type-safe codebase |
| **Tailwind CSS 4** | Utility-first styling |
| **Shiki** | Syntax highlighting engine (100+ languages) |
| **Better Auth** | Authentication and user management |
| **PostgreSQL** | Primary database |
| **Drizzle ORM** | ORM and migrations |
| **tRPC** | Typed API layer |
| **Dodo Payments** | Payment processing for Pro and Premium |
| **Jotai** | Atomic state management |
| **Motion** | Animation library |
| **AWS Amplify** | Hosting and deployment |

---

## Getting Started (Local Development)

### Prerequisites
- Node.js 20+
- npm
- PostgreSQL database (local or hosted)

### Setup

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/simpleneeraj/cool-snippets.git
cd cool-snippets

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Create .env.local with the required values:
#   DATABASE_URL: PostgreSQL connection string
#   BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: Better Auth secret
#   BETTER_AUTH_URL: App URL, e.g. http://localhost:3000

# Set up the database
npm run db:migrate

# Start the development server
npm run dev
```

The app will be available at `http://localhost:3000`.

### Build for Production

```bash
npm run build
npm start
```

## Project Structure

```
cool-snippets/
├── public/              # Static assets, llms.txt, llms-full.txt
├── drizzle/             # SQL migrations
├── src/
│   ├── app/             # Next.js App Router pages and layouts
│   │   ├── (navigation)/ # Editor, preview, remix, profile, snippets, embed
│   │   ├── account/     # Sign-in, sign-up, password reset
│   │   ├── api/         # Auth, tRPC and cron routes
│   │   ├── checkout/    # Checkout result pages
│   │   └── pricing/     # Pricing page
│   ├── components/      # React components, including theme presets
│   ├── db/              # Drizzle schema
│   ├── lib/             # Auth, billing and shared logic
│   ├── server/          # tRPC routers
│   └── store/           # Jotai atoms and state management
├── drizzle.config.ts    # Drizzle configuration
├── next.config.ts       # Next.js configuration
└── package.json
```

---

## How Themes Work

Each theme is a configuration object that defines:
- **Background:** Gradient, solid color, image, or animated scene behind the frame
- **Editor colors:** Syntax highlighting colors for the code editor
- **Frame style:** Window chrome appearance, border radius, shadows
- **Accent colors:** Highlight colors for UI elements

Themes live in `src/components/presets/` and can be selected from the theme picker in the editor UI.

---

## Snippet URL Format

Published snippets follow this URL pattern:
```
https://www.cutecode.app/preview/{slug}
```

Each snippet URL preserves:
- The full source code
- Selected theme
- Editor settings (font size, padding, line numbers, etc.)
- Language selection

---

## API & Integration

### Embeddable Previews
Use the `/embed` route to embed live, read-only code previews:
```
https://www.cutecode.app/embed/{slug}
```

### Shareable URLs
Every published snippet has a unique URL that can be shared on social media, documentation, or chat.

### Open Source
CuteCode is open source under the MIT License. Contributions, issues, and pull requests are welcome.

## FAQ

**Is CuteCode free?**
Yes. The core features (code screenshots, Classic and Brand themes, PNG and SVG export, and publishing) are free. Pro and Premium plans add premium themes, higher-resolution exports, watermark-free output and more.

**Can I self-host CuteCode?**
Yes. CuteCode is open source under the MIT License. Clone the repo, set up your environment, and deploy anywhere that supports Next.js.

**What languages are supported?**
CuteCode supports 100+ programming languages through Shiki, including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, Java, C++, Ruby, Swift, Kotlin, and many more.

**How do I share a snippet?**
Publish your snippet (requires sign-in), then copy its /preview URL. Anyone with the link can view and remix your snippet.

**Can I use CuteCode screenshots commercially?**
Yes. Screenshots you create are yours. The tool itself is MIT-licensed.
